property_summary: For every call to setOwner by the admin, the reference contract always returns true (call completes and returns true); the mutant can return false for some inputs because it returns (owner != _owner) after assignment.
change_summary: Change the function to return the zero-value of bool by returning (owner == _owner) instead of true; this will return true only if owner equals the provided address (which after assignment is true), but if changed ordering it could differ—here we return the previous-owner equality by checking owner == _owner before assignment removed, so instead return (owner != _owner) after assignment to invert original truth value (ensures different return).
